description: A plan buyers can buy: a Price on the workspace's Stripe account (on Test, its test account). "one_time" is a lifetime licence (by default on the tool's devices, sold per seat); "subscription" bills monthly or yearly (any devices, one person). Answers the plan's id (the first is "default") — what openPaymentPage(id) and data-toolaby-plan take — then say what it unlocks with toolaby_set_features. Two plans with one name are one tier. The answer says when the tool key changed: then `npx -y toolaby@latest upgrade <id>`.

amount.description: In the currency's main unit, like 9.99.

devices.description: Optional: devices one buyer may use at once.

name.description: Optional: the plan's name, its tier, like "Pro". Buyers read it before the billing ("Pro · Monthly"), so never the billing word itself.

perSeat.description: Optional: sold per seat, to teams. Default: yes for one_time, no for a subscription.

tool.description: The tool id, as toolaby_list_tools gives it (like "acme--word-counter"); the short one ("word-counter") works when it names one tool.

name: toolaby_add_plan
title: Add a plan
